chunks: Surely those who fear and follow the straight path will be in a place of peace and security

key_terms.أَمِينٍ: Secure, safe, free from fear or instability
key_terms.الْمُتَّقِينَ: The God-fearing, those who possess taqwa (God-consciousness)

ai.seo_question: What is the final destination and state of the God-fearing according to Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Aman* (security) granted to the *Ahl al-Bayt* and the faithful during times of tribulation, reflecting both spiritual tranquility and physical safety from divine wrath. The 'secure abode' signifies not only the eternal peace of Paradise but also the stability of the divine covenant for those who maintain *Taqwa* amidst worldly chaos.
